description: A supersaw made from a 1983 transistor organ, a layered Vaporizer lead inside it and an eighties Oberheim lead on top

name: Techno Pressure
author: Ghost Atlas
description: The melodic-techno bass: a Vaporizer bass with Odin's growling FM bass under it and a DX7 FM bass giving each note its click

name: Pulse Engine
author: Ghost Atlas
description: A big analog stack and a saw wall chopped by the trance gate in time with the song, a sub under the gate and a dotted echo filling the gaps
